entities.name: Krosa
entities.description: A forest region on the continent Otaria on Dominaria, between Tamingazin and Pardia, home to druids and large animals.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Barbarian-turned-druid who planted the Mirari in Krosa and used its beasts during the Nightmare War.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: Artifact planted in Krosa whose power mutated the forest's inhabitants.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Poachers who captured Krosan beasts for pit fights; the Patriarch corrupted the forest's foundations.

entities.name: Gorgon Mount
entities.description: Huge overgrown hill that grew where the sword impaled the ground.

entities.name: Nightmare War
entities.description: War in which Kamahl used Krosan beasts.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: Kamahl's sister, who became Phage again.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: Her apocalypse weakened mana throughout Dominaria.

entities.name: Zyd
entities.description: Druid dedicated to Kamahl's memory and restoring Krosa.

entities.name: Baru
entities.description: Druid dedicated to Kamahl's memory and restoring Krosa.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which Krosa grew denser.

events.summary: In the century after the Phyrexian Invasion Krosa grows larger and denser, wildlife grows fiercer and the druids grow suspicious.
events.quote: In the century following the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria

events.summary: Kamahl plants the Mirari in the ground of Krosa, whose power mutates the inhabitants and turns beasts into monsters.
events.quote: It was he who planted the Mirari into the ground of Krosa

events.summary: Kamahl uses the powerful beasts in the Nightmare War, then returns to Krosa in defeat after his sister becomes Phage again.
events.quote: then returned to dwell in Krosa in defeat after his sister had once more become Phage

events.summary: Krosa's trees decay after Karona's apocalypse, but the druids remain, dedicated to Kamahl's memory.
events.quote: Krosa's trees decayed, leaving the forest a shadow of its former grandeur
